targets.note: Where the bundle should return to. The route budgets above are a ceiling that stops further growth (re-baselined 2026-11-14 at about 3% over a production build of main after C-8a and C-8d; home fetchedJsBytesAllFrames, the JS of every frame including the project previews it embeds in iframes, added 2026-11-15 at 3% over 5,547,788 measured on Linux, Actions run 43671702173, where no other route attached an iframe; home fetchedCssBytesAllFrames, the CSS of the same frames, and fetchedJsBytesFullPage, the JS of every frame after scrolling to the bottom so lazy previews below the fold count, added the same day at 3% over 726,756 and 5,551,212 measured on Linux, Actions run 43682379581; route JS on home, components, butter, eu26 and heavy-visual raised the same day for PR 2186, see raises below; butter and eu26 fetchedJsBytes and home fetchedJsBytesAllFrames, fetchedJsBytesFullPage and fetchedCssBytesAllFrames lowered 2026-11-15 to 3% over the C-8 measurement on Linux, Actions run 43730355363: butter 5,722,994, eu26 3,976,984, home all-frames JS 3,144,683, home full-page JS 3,144,683 and home all-frames CSS 707,521, about 19 KB less CSS because the embedded project previews no longer load the chat and editor stylesheets until a chat or composer opens; re-measured on the review fixes in Actions run 43737065973 within 5 KB of those), not a goal. Met and removed: Rovo first-load JS 7,100,000 (6,917,433 after C-8d). The CSS target is met on home, butter, eu26 and heavy-visual (696,019); rovo, studio (754,612) and components (707,178) are still above it. From 2026-11-19, routeJsBytes excludes the root app/page chunk on every route except /: Next lists that chunk in every route's client-reference manifest, but only / loads it. Earlier route-JS measurements are not directly comparable. Butter and eu26 routeJsBytes budgets were re-set from the new measurement; components, rovo and studio keep their earlier budgets, which now carry about 8,000 bytes of slack from the old count (the owner has not decided to lower them).

margin.note: How far a budget may sit above the measured value it is set from: the larger of ratio x the value and the metric's floor, rounded up to a whole thousand bytes (counts are not rounded). Provisional; the owner decides. Builds of unchanged code measure the same bytes, so the margin is room for ordinary product changes, not noise: on the nine main runs from bf64b91f8 to 00de69100, single merges added 0.5 to 5.7 KB of route JS, which 3% of a 60 KB route (about 1.8 KB) cannot absorb.
